title: Batch Cart
summary: Combine scaled recipes into one accurate shopping list.
user: People cooking several recipes for a household or event who need one accurate shopping list after changing servings for each recipe.
smallest_useful_product: Browser-local recipe cards or pasted ingredients; per-recipe servings; deterministic unit-aware aggregation; pantry checkbox exclusions; and a print/share shopping list.
constraints: Use only user-entered or imported recipes. Preserve original units and show uncertain conversions. Do not scrape recipes.
